answer: Require every new agent to enter through one bonded inlet: it locks a refundable stake and must complete a series of verifiable useful tasks over several days before earning full rights. A reputation prism then scores its record separately by task type, so one strong result cannot hide failures elsewhere. Copying an identity therefore multiplies the stake and waiting time, while repeated failures trigger a spiral of stricter checks and longer delays, making a large fake fleet expensive to build and easy to isolate.
